title: Quantum Square · partial sums

target.description: Q1 quantum Square attack on 6-round AES-128; source boundary omits the last linear layer for notation. The explicit algorithms recover selected terminal subkey bytes; no additional full-master-key success law is inferred.

setting.key_relation: One fixed standard AES master key and its key schedule.
setting.plaintext_model: 2^35 classical chosen plaintexts in 2^32 diagonal structures.
assumptions: Quantum random access to the partial-sum table is required; classical data memory is separate.
